product.title: Small Group: Michelin and Local Hawker Food Tour with 9 tastings

description.text: In Singapore, this small-group Chinatown hawker walk leaves Chinatown MRT Exit E at 9:30 am for nine to ten tastings at Michelin Guide and Bib Gourmand stalls. Published stops include Maxwell Food Centre, South Bridge Road, Sago Street, and Chinatown Street Market, with Jamae Mosque, Sri Mariamman Temple, and Buddha Tooth Relic Temple listed as pass-bys. The group is capped at ten. Food and drinks on the tasting list are included; transport and extra purchases stay separate. The walk ends at Chinatown Complex on Smith Street. The format suits visitors who want a guided hawker introduction without queuing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Chinatown, Maxwell Food Centre, Sago Street, and Chinatown Street Market that define this tasting rather than a Little India add-on.
